data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: इसे चखो और बताओ, यह 'chef's kiss' है।

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = बिल्कुल परिपूर्ण. उदाहरण: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
native.caption:
“chef's kiss” का मतलब क्या है?
“chef's kiss” = बिल्कुल परिपूर्ण.
उदाहरण: “The soup was chef's kiss.” (सूप 'chef's kiss' था।)
